name: Naraku no Hana
source:
Hayasaka, a teacher who works at a certain school, becomes lustful when she sees Saya sleeping when she comes to school on her day off, and ends up playing a prank on her.
After that, Hayasaka's abnormal sexual love for Saya begins.

[Translated From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ119283.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
在某所学校工作的早坂老师，在放假到学校时看到沙耶睡着了，就产生了好色之心，并对她进行了恶作剧。
此后，早坂对沙耶的异常性爱开始了。
